aliases: rank nine yellow apricot immortal essence Giant Sun's immortal essence

summary.text: Yellow apricot immortal essence is rank nine immortal essence. Only venerables form it, and leftover beads can still power Immortal Gu Houses and wills after the venerable dies.

claims.text: Inside Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, Giant Sun Immortal Venerable left a large amount of rank nine yellow apricot immortal essence. The Immortal Gu House absorbs that leftover essence under Giant Sun’s will and activates as if the process were natural.
Gu Immortals cannot use the immortal essence of others, and Giant Sun’s immortal essence can only be used by Giant Sun’s will.
Eighty-Eight True Yang Building holds Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s yellow apricot immortal essence beside Water Pavilion’s red date immortal essence on Fang Yuan during that fight.

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable was rank nine. The immortal essence he left is yellow apricot immortal essence that only rank nine venerables can form. Its quality is countless times greater than green grape immortal essence, a gap the text likens to the difference between heaven and earth. Fang Yuan himself cannot use Giant Sun’s immortal essence, but an Immortal Gu House can absorb it, which is a fundamental trait of Immortal Gu Houses: integrating the power of a group of immortals into one.

Immortal essence at rank eight is white litchi immortal essence. Immortal essence at rank nine is slightly larger, looks like an apricot, and is orange-yellow. That bead is yellow apricot immortal essence. As a venerable, Fang Yuan produces yellow apricot immortal essence, which is much more useful than white litchi immortal essence, while immortal essence stones become barely useful at that height.
One immortal essence stone equals one green grape immortal essence bead; each yellow apricot immortal essence bead is worth a million immortal essence stones.
Rank scale sits on ranks and realms.
